events.title: v0.2.7: Science Overhaul
events.summary: Science OverhaulThis is a small update with a focus on Science Balancing.Each item now has its own science value, and no longer uses the sale price. The more crafting steps go into an item, the higher the science efficiency: an Iron Bar yields science 4 times as fast as a raw item, and an Engine 16 times as fast.The science car now also takes raw items, for 1 science point each.Other notable changesCheaper recipes: Iron Plate and Screw now cost 120 credits each (was 200), Scrap Ingot now costs 4

events.title: v0.2.5: Ground Scans
events.summary: This update introduces the new Ground Scans minigame.After you repaired the scan drone in the Refinery stage, activate it to scan the ground. You have a short period of time to boost the ratios of ores.We heard your feedback about ore ratios! events.title: Factory on a Train: New Demo for NextFest
events.summary: A whole new demoOver the past months we threw away the old demo and rebuilt Factory on a Train from scratch. The idea is the same, but the game around it is new. If you played before, give it another ride!One journeyThe old demo split the game into runs, stations and a workshop. Now it is one long trip through the wasteland.
